name: menumap
description: Find places to eat and what they serve: restaurants, any dish across every menu, full menus with EUR prices, opening hours and directions, read from each restaurant's own website. Connects to the MenuMap MCP server at caniseethemenu.com/mcp.

interface.longDescription: Find places to eat and what they serve. MenuMap has each restaurant's full menu, item by item with EUR prices, read from the restaurant's own website, and adds cities over time. Ask where to get a dish and what it costs, find restaurants by cuisine, name or neighbourhood or near a place, and read menus, opening hours and contact details.
defaultPrompt: Where can I get a good burger, and what does it cost?
